copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: 这个技能会让Claude根据用户的要求，生成3D纸艺弹出书风格的插画。插画具有立体层次、纸质纹理、明亮温暖的色调（薄荷绿、天蓝、珊瑚橙、奶油黄），并可加入科技元素。
howto.when: 当用户要求生成纸艺质感、立体层次、特定色调（薄荷绿/天蓝/珊瑚橙/奶油黄）的插画时触发。

say.text: 用弹出书风格画一幅科技主题插画
say.note: 会生成含科技元素的立体纸艺插画

say.text: 生成一张薄荷绿和天蓝配色的纸艺插画
画一本打开的书，里面有立体弹出结构
say.note: 会呈现书本场景与弹出层次

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to create 3D paper pop-up book illustrations with layered depth, paper texture, bright warm colors (mint, sky blue, coral, cream), and optional tech elements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an illustration with paper craft texture, layered depth, or specific colors (mint green/sky blue/coral orange/cream yellow).

say_en.text: Draw a tech-themed illustration in pop-up book style.
say_en.note: Generates a layered paper art piece with tech elements.

say_en.text: Generate a paper art illustration with mint green and sky blue colors.
Draw an open book with 3D pop-up structures.
say_en.note: Shows a book scene with depth.
